Title: ​​ ​​ Developer Analyst 3 
 Location:​ Austin, TX 
 Description 
 ​ 
 · Development of new batch or online programs and modifications of existing programs including developing and modifying reports 
 · Developing complex SQL Queries in a DB2 z/OS environment to assist with data analysis and to update data based on specific business requirements 
 A senior level Programmer / Developer Analyst must have a strong background in data and database analysis with DB2 z/OS DBMS and be able to analyze data for irregularities and patterns. Must be able to quickly develop expertise in complex systems, be quality conscious and be dedicated to delivering quality products on time and on budget. Experience with COBOL is not required, but is desirable. 


 8 years of Natural experience is required
